meta.name: sdxl_cutout_lora_v1
meta.description: SDXL txt2img + LoRA + RGBA-cutout graph (T-0220/T-0221, docs/design/13-asset-pipeline.md §6.15). CheckpointLoaderSimple -> LoraLoader -> CLIPTextEncode x2 + EmptyLatentImage(gen dims) -> KSampler -> VAEDecode -> SolidMask(gen dims) + JoinImageWithAlpha -> ImageScale(game dims, area) -> SaveImage. Produces RGBA PNG at game-pixel dimensions. NOTE: ComfyUI JoinImageWithAlpha INVERTS the mask (value=0.0 → opaque, value=1.0 → transparent); render_cutout_workflow() applies 1.0-solid_mask_value before writing node 13 so solid_mask_value=1.0 (the user-facing 'fully opaque') correctly produces alpha=255. Node 13 SolidMask uses generation dimensions (gen_width/gen_height from render_cutout_workflow); node 15 ImageScale resizes the RGBA output to recipe.width/height (game pixel dimensions). Node IDs are stable; add a new template file for graph-shape changes, never edit node IDs in place.
